sections.title: Profile
sections.text: Gitano is a mystic from Sami, tarot expert and a great card player. She has never spoken to anyone of her past prior coming to Rhodes Island, and it remains a mystery. All anyone knows is that her readings are very accurate.

sections.title: Clinical Analysis
sections.text:
Imaging tests for this Operator showed blurry outlines of internal organs with visible dark spots. Unusually high concentrations of Originium particles were present in her circulatory system, indicating infection and confirming her as Infected at this stage.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5%
The infection could be related to Operator Gitano's arcane abilities, though this has yet been proven..

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.3u/L
Infection approaching mid-stage, Originium beginning to have physical effects that are not obvious.

sections.title: Archive File 1
sections.text: A fortune teller cannot tell her own future, but she can read the omens and guide her choices. She has the power to create devastating explosions with her Originium crystal ball, but she must also withstand the backlash.

sections.title: Archive File 2
sections.text: Divination is a hobby to Gitano that she does almost for free, accepting fruits and cakes as a token payment. Her clients ask for readings on anything from the future to a misplaced key. Just like any soothsayer, Gitano gives ambiguous answers that require some careful thought to decipher.

sections.title: Archive File 3
sections.text: Unlike her relaxed composure during a reading, Gitano gets anxious easily and becomes very competitive when playing cards. She is never allowed to shuffle the deck out of fear that she'll cheat. Even then, she knows countless other card tricks, and unless she's caught red-handed, she'll never admit to cheating. Still, some people play with her because they either want to catch her in the act, or see a nervous side of her she doesn't otherwise show.
